My name is Junwei (Ivy) Sun and I am originally from Shanghai, China. I am a second-year Biostatistics PhD student at Johns Hopkins University with interests in genomics, AI/ML, and their intersection (perhaps this falls under AI for Science:). Currently I am exploring the use of agentic AI to accelerate scientific workflows and discovery, and I am equally interested in statistical tools that assess when such systems can be trusted. The main focus area I have explored is single-cell perturbation modeling, where I benchmark published perturbation models and audit frontier coding agents on how they approach this open biological problem.
